data.bio: Dedicated, result-driven Physics educator passionate about experiential, activity-driven teaching. Specialist in setting up Composite Science & STEM Labs and conducting pan-India student workshops aligned with NEP 2020.
data.name: Devender (Dev Sharma)
data.title: Senior Physics Faculty | Master Trainer & Composite Lab Architect
data.subject: Physics Faculty

data.content: Dedicated and result-oriented Physics educator with strong subject expertise and a passion for experiential, hands-on teaching. Skilled in simplifying complex concepts through experiments, models, and activity-based learning aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. Proven track record in Experimental, STEM and Composite Lab Development, Curriculum Development, and academic management. Experienced in conducting physics workshops and faculty training programs across reputed schools in India. Seeking to contribute energetic teaching, strong administrative coordination, and a deep commitment to building future-ready, lab-driven learning environments for students.
data.heading: Career Objective

cards.title: 10% - 20% Retention
points: Passive listening and memorizing derivations without physical context.
Concepts like Electromagnetism & Optics feel abstract and intimidating.
High exam stress when facing twisted numerical questions.

cards.title: 75% - 90% Retention
points: Dual-Coding Theory: Audio + Visual + Hands-on experimentation.
Live Apparatus Proofs: Concepts verified with working models first.
Effortless Recall: Students recall live experiments naturally during exams.

data.headline: Why Experiential Learning? (Audio-Visual + Hands-On = 90% Retention)
data.description: Textbook lectures only produce 10–20% retention because abstract formulas fade quickly. When students experience Audio-Visual + Hands-On Physical Demonstrations, neural encoding deepens, making Board Exams and JEE/NEET problem-solving intuitive and permanent.
